{{Quote|Ah, erm&mdash;my master, Xoff, wonders what he can do for you.|D3-LOM rephrases a rude question from Xoff Ix|<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref>}}
'''D3-LOM''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked for an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Unidentified Ugnaught construction guild|construction guild]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] served as a translator for the guild's chief foreman in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], [[Xoff Ix]], who only spoke [[Ugnaught (language)/Legends|Ugnaught]]. When a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visited Ix to try and acquire schematics of Cloud City for use planning a heist, D3-LOM translated for the group, rephrasing many of the foreman's rude replies or questions to be more polite. The group successfully acquired a replica of the plans for a payment of 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. At the time of the meeting D3-LOM was creaky and in need of an [[Oil bath/Legends|oil bath]].<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin" />

==Behind the scenes==
D3-LOM first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. This article makes no assumption as to how players acquired the schematics, but it does assume they were successful in doing do.
